articles.description: Alejandro Moreno reacts to Portugal's first win without Cristiano Ronaldo, triumphing over Wales in the Nations League.

articles.headline: Fjørtoft: Haaland is 'Gerd Müller level' for Norway
articles.description: Jan Åge Fjørtoft praises Erling Haaland's performance for Norway in their 2-3 win over Denmark to advance to the Nations League quarter-finals.

articles.headline: Republic of Ireland clinch Nations League play-offs after beating Kosovo
articles.description: Troy Parrott fired the Republic of Ireland into a Nations League play-off berth with two penalties in their 3-0 victory over 10-man Kosovo at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin.

articles.headline: Haaland sends Norway to Nations League quarters on last-minute penalty
articles.description: Erling Haaland delivered for Norway on one of the last plays of the game to give his team a 3-2 win over Denmark to advance to the Nations League quarterfinals.

articles.headline: Northern Ireland draw with Hungary enough to seal Nations League promotion
articles.description: Justin Devenny's superb strike saw Northern Ireland earn promotion to the top flight of the Nations League with a hard-fought 1-1 draw away to closest challengers Hungary in Budapest.

articles.headline: Portugal edge Wales for 1st win of post-Ronaldo era despite Neto red card
